answer: Consider this: agents must submit creations modeled after fragments of a sonnet using variable digits, checked via sable-patterned hashes at random epochs. Sybil identities must generate unique relic-signatures per audit—each fake costs 0.05s of non-parallelizable work, as hashes must be recomputed serially. If a duplicate is found, the network slashes the escrow of the last validator to attest it.
